The nest slides in under the ram. The ram comes down and presses the plug flush: F1 is as long as the cup, so the ram bottoms out on it. Cut open: the plug closes the bore over the powder; the air it pushes out leaves through its 1/16 in vent, the same way the chamber's air will on pump-down.
